arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ إِنّا أَنزَلنٰهُ فى لَيلَةِ القَدرِ
translation: Lo! We revealed it on the Night of Predestination
Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Night of Power is

arabic: لَيلَةُ القَدرِ خَيرٌ مِن أَلفِ شَهرٍ
transliteration: Laylatu alqadri khayrun min alfi shahrin
translation: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months

arabic: تَنَزَّلُ المَلٰئِكَةُ وَالرّوحُ فيها بِإِذنِ رَبِّهِم مِن كُلِّ أَمرٍ
transliteration: Tanazzalu almalaikatu waalrroohu feeha biithni rabbihim min kulli amrin
translation: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees
(The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn
